about: Every test that uses development parts under the ML plan of 2026-10 (docs/research/ml-plan-2026-10.md, step 0). Each entry gives its plan, the parts and bands it used, its gate, and its outcome. A step's gate is entered before its results exist; 'outcome' is filled after. Held-out uses stay in docs/validation-datasets.json (held_out_uses).

tests.gate: Step A (provisional; m_A, mask v, lags 0 and -52 must agree): >= 15 of 18 informative searches agree with gap closed >= 50%, AND within the C' run m_A > 0 on >= 2 of 3 successes and m_A <= 0 on >= 4 of 6 failures -> provisional gate; 13-14 or the C' row fails -> screen only; <= 12 -> not adopted. Final only if the pre-registered per-cell predictions for experiment 3's control re-runs agree on >= two-thirds of informative searches. Step B (primary m_full, measure-DI mask for D1/D2; inversions counted on informative cells with base m > 0; halves, other mask and leave-one-band-out reported as fragility): placebo smear inverts > 1 -> D1 undecided. D1: crest -3 dB inverts >= half (rounded up) of reached cells with >= 5 reached, and the C'-spectrum rung inverts <= 1 -> dynamics confirmed; crest holds and C'-spectrum >= 2 -> dynamics and tilt; crest fails and C'-spectrum >= half -> tilt, not dynamics; else neither. D2: a transplant (5 ms, 10 ms, or oracle-EQ + 10 ms) restores if m > 0 on >= two-thirds of the base set and on more cells than C'. D3: a proxy is adopted if band-weighted within-cell Spearman rho >= 0.6, the paired band-clustered bootstrap lower 90% bound of (rho - coherence's rho) > 0, and it beats coherence in >= 5 of 6 bands; confirmation on other development cells is binding before any use as a loss.
tests.outcome: done 2026-10-15 (840 renders + 81 audit): step A 14/18 -> screen only (C' run 5/9, rho 0). D1 neither (crest-3 1/7, C'-spectrum 1/9, placebo 0/9). D2 'restores' by count (transplant 8/9 vs C' 5/9) but recovers ~6% of C' margin loss (0.053->0.064 vs 0.244); oracle EQ alone passes the same count; read as no substantive restore. D3 none adopted. C' error is fine structure (<10 ms). Experiment 3 not run; experiment 4 redesigned for fine structure.

tests.gate: Descriptive screen, not a gate (the margin agrees with search success on 14 of 18 only). Cells: 5 parts x PR12, SW50R; informative = d_S - d_T >= 0.1 (full window, measure DI, clean fake). Primary m_full. A row (mega53, blend) earns the merged report's full switching test only if m_sep > 0 on more informative cells than htdemucs_6s, AND no informative cell flips from m_sep > 0 (htdemucs_6s) to m_sep <= 0, AND its mean real-song 1-3 kHz coherence (check-2 measure, the part's fold C') >= htdemucs_6s's - 0.02. Coherence alone never advances a row; m_both is reported, not gating. Reading on htdemucs_6s, independent of the screen: m_sep <= 0 on <= 1 informative cell -> separation isn't what breaks the objective; on >= ceil(n/3) -> co-equal problem, re-test promoted; else partial. n < 4 informative, or an htdemucs_6s lag-check failure on an informative cell -> undecided. Fragility (m_A, m_B, other mask, leave-one-part-out with n' rescaling) reported beside each verdict.
tests.outcome: done 2026-10-16 (136 renders; audited): informative 10/10; m_sep>0 htdemucs 9/10 (mean 0.113), Mega-53 10/10 (0.110), clean 0.221; reading not-separation (1 inversion), robust. Mega-53 advances by rule on one cell (get-out-of-bed PR12), fragile without that part, mean delta -0.003: no evidence it separates better. Blend doesn't advance (2 cells stopped by +-1 relative lag; labelled flips, harsher than the plan). m_both: htdemucs 6/10, Mega-53 7/10, clean 7/10: the rebuild is the bigger break.

tests.gate: Full known-target control only (margin reported, never gating). Step 4 passes if >= 6 of 9 informative cells close >= 50% of the gap, or the informative-cell mean shortfall <= measure-DI run's + 0.03 = -0.0315 (one-sided); the 5 non-fold-3 cells reported apart. Step 2 (fold 3, 4 cells, stricter than the readout's <6-cell mode): go if >= 3 of 4 close >= 50% or mean shortfall <= -0.013; stop if <= 2 of 4 and mean > +0.171; else undecided. At most 3 arms rendered (1a, 1b, better of 1c/1e by 1d's 1-ms crest). If any arm reads go or undecided, 1z is rendered at lag 0; if 1z meets go, gains are attributed to fine-tuning; an arm beats 1z only with more cells closed or a mean shortfall >= 0.03 lower; tie-break 1z, 1a, 1b, 1e, 1c. Any go wins; only undecided arms (no go) take the fold-1 branch (user's yes; per-arm fold-1 fine-tunes): 7 cells, go if >= 5 of 7 or mean <= -0.048, stop if <= 4 of 7 and mean > +0.202, else undecided and ask. Step 5: the control's own rule with amendment 2 on a fresh 12-cell draw, band-weighted with leave-one-band-out; row 1 there -> undecided, ask the user; only a pass re-runs arm A. 1d hard stops are breakage guards only (val ratio > C' + 0.02, check 2 < 0.1126, 3-8 kHz > C' + 2 dB); crest and gap reported and used only to rank. 0c opens E1' (for experiment 4 only) if DAC-9 keeps m > 0 on 4 of 4 fold-3 cells, fold-3 mean m >= 0.75 x the true DI's (0c's own scoring), 1-ms crest within 1 dB.

tests.gate: Diagnostic. Units informative if d_S, d_T and the target are finite on the held half and d_S - d_T >= 0.1; non-finite units dropped and listed; refused candidates count as not closing and are out of means. Counts are unweighted unit shares within a fold; means band-weighted; pooled band-clustered 90% intervals; fragile = a fold pass flips with one band left out. Set-up: pre-flight repeat <= 1e-3 on non-target renders, target repeat within 1e-3 on >= 95% of targets, >= 40 informative units per fold after top-up, top-mean parity. R1 (per view): top mean closes >= 50% on >= 2/3 and strictly closer than the bank median on >= 2/3. R2 (per view): best-of-K truncated-normal samples (K=4 view 1a, 8 view 1b) picked on the search half close >= 50% on >= 2/3 and mean held log ratio <= -0.03 vs best-of-K random labels and vs best-of-K S-jitters. Per view R1/R2: pass = every fold, none fragile; undecided (ask the user) = 3 of 4 folds, or any fragile pass (fold 3 included); else fail. R3: R1 passes on 1a and fails on 1b, or R2 at K=4 passes on 1a and fails on 1b at K=4. R4 (pool: every distinct setting for the target except target, repeat and S, on the unit's held half; pooled unweighted per fold): >= 1/3 of renders closing >= 50% lie >= 0.2 mean knob distance from the target, and >= 2 of the 4 continuous-only target jitters close >= 50% on >= 2/3 of units. R4': that share < 10% and band-weighted within-unit Spearman(knob distance, gap closed) <= -0.5. Neither or folds split: between. Triggers (first match): set-up fails -> stop; R1 on 1b -> rung 2, no experiments 2-3; R2 on 1b -> 3A (or arm C if experiment 4 passes), step 1.3 offered (ask first; 'renders only' puts rung 3 before any product step); R1/R2 undecided -> ask the user; R3 -> experiment 2 as confirmation, then song-robustness; both views fail -> experiment 2, then by R4 (3B), R4' (front-end follow-up), between (experiment 2 alone decides). Flags: collapse (median mode separation sum_k pi_k|mu_k - mu_bar| / sum_k pi_k sigma_k over audible settings < 0.5 in >= 3 of 4 folds; threshold set after the audit was readable) picks 3B's flow head; label sampling (K_S-prior half meets R1/R2 counts, broad half not, >= 3 of 4 folds); flat settings (median Delta-judge < 0.05) dropped from knob diagnostics
tests.renders: budgeted ~7.9k (pre-flight ~10, step 1.1 <= 7,080, step 1.2 ~0.8k), hard stop 8.2k including any top-up; step 1.3 ~2.3k ask-first, only on row 2. Only the band-weighted pooled mean decides. Decision: best estimate; a candidate whose paired 90% interval with the best contains 0 is a tie (fold-3 steps: the wider of the band (2 df) and part (4 df) intervals); among the best and its ties the first in the frozen cost order is chosen. Exp 1 order: S, C-blend, B-blend, C' menu pick, A, S-mics, shrink-0.5, shrink-0.25, shrink-0.75 (dirs-avg reported, not eligible). Exp 2 order: C', 1z, 1a, 1b, E4={C',1z,1a,1b}; deciding lag -52 - (GCC lag vs C'). 2b only if exp 2 leaves a tie, deciding among the tied set by local fidelity. Exp 3: 3-C' (zero-render replay of the stored main stage) vs S and full A on 142 directions; 3a: S, 3-C', full A, 3-W on fold 3; 3b only if 3a chooses 3-W; E4 in 3b needs the user's yes. tests.training: B0's body and recipe (40 epochs, patience 5, batch 64, lr 1e-3, hand-clipped gradients) with a censored continuous head (mean -1 + 3 sigmoid; limit labels within 1e-6 score the tail mass) and B0's group normalisation with sensitivity weights s_j inside the continuous and switch groups (step 1.2 medians / amp mean, clipped [0.25, 4]; right-cab level, distance, position from cab-on bases and masked with the right mic when the label's right cab is off; mics B0's weight); K_S-centred examples weighted to half the training loss (not on validation); early stopping on each arm's own loss. tests.gate: No pass/fail bars. Measured: held-half judge distance through the measure DI, as log ratios. Compared: per target/part means, band-weighted with 90% band-clustered intervals (training-seed variance not included; B1' - B1 reported as a yardstick), leave-one-band-out, part-weighted, per amp and class (crunch descriptive). Refusals: only pre-existing drops apply to all arms; a new arm's non-finite held half scores as S (log ratio 0), counted per arm, also per sample in best-of-K. Decides: the songs' top answer vs S (E3) on the songs' yes; otherwise, provisionally, E1's view-1b top answer vs S on broad targets only, with the K_S-prior half beside it and 'undecided' if the halves name different winners. DESCRIPTIVE, ZERO RENDERS, ZERO SEPARATIONS, decides nothing: where the tone information is lost between the rendered guitar and D_F5's input. Probe training: F5's 3,467 training examples (59 sections); read: FS5's 722 (12 sections), the split of D_F5 and R0; labels the full twins' (full_space.encode). Inputs: (a) the full-twin target's stored half mels (tgt-t3); (b) the self-built mix's (mix-t3); (c) the X-LANCE stem's (xlance_g-t3); (d) (a) plus the section DI's half mels (song_bank.measure of section_audio, trimmed as the target); (e) the stored target audio at a finer representation (4096-point STFT, 5 ms hop, 160 log bands 30 Hz-24 kHz, unquantised); (n) negative control, the DI alone; beside, R0's D_F5 rows. Probe: the same per input: per-half summaries (per band mean, sd, p10/p50/p90, mean |frame change|; 8 band-group envelopes' autocorrelation at 16 lags 10 ms-1.8 s and change percentiles; broadband envelope stats), halves averaged, half A's first second masked; amp and class one-hot (not for the amp head); ridge per head, penalty from 10^-1..10^7 by 5-fold section-grouped CV on the probe-training set only; knobs predict the residual from D_F5's constant (fit.json), clipped; switches ranked scores; mics and amp one-vs-rest argmax; each head trained where scored. Per family and input: readable count, median gain over chance. tests.amendment_5_fix: The audibility fresh-process recipe (ROADMAP (c)) (2026-10-27; written after the first run of amendment 5 and before any re-render; within the user's yes of that day). Why: the first run (2026-10-27 09:44-09:57, 896 renders) was audited independently. Morgan's tremolo, tape delay and rack reverb run on across renders in one plugin process (isolate=True does not reset them), so a render is a fixed function of its position in its process: the audit's 8 diagnostic renders (4 new processes) were bit-identical across processes at the same position and differed between positions in one process (example 59 by -8.6 dB, 4107 fully decorrelated); the SW50R spring alone was bit-identical. The first run compared each new r_off with the stored target and stored mix, rendered in other processes at other positions: only 2 of 36 repeats passed the mel check, the repeat floor's A_e had median 0.0017, 75th percentile 0.0074, 90th 0.0156 (tau 0.005), so about a third of the pairs' tau calls were unreliable; 675 of 824 pairs kept another modulated effect on in r_off; 19 of the page's 20 near-tau pairs had one running out of phase, so the page is not sent. Not a code bug: the recipe, alignment and level matched. New definitions: every render runs in its own new plugin process, one discarded priming render with the example's own setting (r_on's), then the one render kept (the priming rule kept, isolate=True, 0.25 s trimmed). r_on' is that render of the example's own setting; r_off the same with the effect off, at the same process position; m' is r_on' in the example's stored backing at its stored gains and mastering (mix_with, checked first to rebuild the stored mix from the stored target, then the stored mix features and gains checked as before). A_e = |mean over halves of log(J(r_off, m') / J(r_on', m'))|; solo J(r_off, r_on'). The repeat: r_on' rendered again in a new process once per (section, amp) group (36); it must be bit-identical (the float samples' sha256), or render and measure refuse. All pairs are redone, one recipe: the first run's draw (seed 20261113) unchanged, 483 r_on' + 824 r_off + 36 repeats = 1,343 jobs, each 2 renders = 2,686 renders (1,343 priming), about 40-70 min on 3 shards with the process starts. The first run is kept as a record (moved, never deleted) under trusted-data/audibility/first-run-2026-10-27/, its page under that folder's page/; the new measure reports the first run's A_e against the new on the clean pairs (no other modulated effect on in r_off; the audit counted 149: delay 38, reverb 44, tremolo 53, PR12 spring 11, SW50R spring 3) as a consistency check. The read, the page (rebuilt from the new renders, both clips at the same process position, each levelled on its own) and everything else in amendment 5 are unchanged. A general caution, flagged and not fixed here: earlier V-real renders render several presets in one process per (part, amp) group, so any comparison in which a time effect is on in both answers carries phase noise from render order. Revised after the independent review of PR #317, before any re-render: the machine-wide cap of 3 render processes is checked once per shard at its start; before each new process a shard waits, printing why, only for a separation and for another job's render server (its sibling shards never count, so they cannot deadlock); render refuses at its start when a stored repeat failed; rows of another recipe refuse; archive moves the plan last; render frees part C's rows and measure runs 2 workers under the disk and memory guard (beside step (b)'s fine-tune). Draws are uniform by session, not by band (Renesans gives 3 sessions, as BKS gives 2 training songs). Each variant stores the pool's hash, and a rebuilt pool cannot reuse old variants. The variants (build-wide): 24 per ladder training example, a session drawn uniformly among the pool's sessions other than the example's own song, then one of its entries, vocal flag p 0.5; built exactly as P2b-bk8's (P2b's own overall gain; a backing gain giving the new bare backing its own bare backing's P2b loudness; its own mastering draw). Rows: P2b-wide24 - P2b-bk8 and - P2b (NS primary, paired), its share of P2a - P2b recovered (cmd_share's rule), - S, - P2a. Reading: a further recovery over P2b-bk8 says more backing variety keeps helping; a null says the variety from these sessions does not add more (masking or too few performances). Caveats, beyond the backing source: the count of variants and the number of sessions both grow, so which of the two helps is not separated; the own input is shown 1 epoch in 25 instead of 1 in 9 (more backing exposure, a different regularising strength); about two-thirds of draws come from new sessions; extra windows may take up to about 20 dB more backing gain than any training backing needs; some extra backings are thin (e.g. kick and bass alone). Each row is one seed with NS-best checkpoints: one seed against the two-seed pool differs by up to about 0.09 by sound (the findings log's caveat), so a wide24 - bk8 difference smaller than that is not read as a change. phase_fx_reader_e1c: Declared 2026-11-03 after F49, amended by its review before any run. Zero renders. E1a's data build (meta sha256 7ec72295...), examples, folds, seed, optimiser, epochs, batches and inner split. Lag head on the stored envelope autocorrelation: each half minus its local mean at +-3-6 lags (edges padded by repetition), 1-D conv per half with shared weights (1->16->16, kernel 5, ReLU, 16->1), halves' logits summed, lags outside 6-80 masked; cross-entropy vs a Gaussian (sigma one lag) at the set lag on delay-ons. A separate model on E1a's batches: weights drawn on a forked RNG stream, own epoch by inner CE, so trunk and heads repeat E1a's. Estimators: within +-10% from argmax; log2 MAE and Spearman from the posterior median lag. Arms stem (primary), mix, target (head check); 24 fold-arms, about 1 h. Comparators: F49's training-free picker (argmax of summed prominence, lags 6-80); training songs' wide-draw median and cell median; all-draw median; E1a's regression time head. Readouts on wide delay-ons (402), all/strong/weak thirds, 90% band-bootstrap intervals (2,000, seed 20261108); all delay-ons; regression knobs vs draw-aware priors; on/off descriptive. Rule: time reads on an arm if within-10% diff vs wide-draw median has interval above 0 and log2 MAE diff below 0; head improves on picker if its within-10% diff vs picker has interval above 0. Head not reading on target or below picker there -> head broken, fixed before the stem counts. Stem reads -> E1b for delay (on/off and time). Not: mix reads -> separator (fine-tuning only); neither -> masking, E1b renders aim there (backing split). Decay not in E1c. Review (the same): 4 required changes to E1c's declaration and code (rule estimator and lag range, the picker as comparator and branches, the conv text, the trunk kept as E1a's), all made.

phase_fx_reader_e1d: Declared 2026-11-03 after the cloud researcher's survey (no proven blind estimator). Zero renders, no training, no download. Real cepstrum averaged over Hann 2^17-sample frames, 0.5 s hop; lags < 40 ms dropped; highest peak in 60-800 ms = time (40-1,500 secondary), height = on/off score; second arm minus the training songs' mean wide delay-off cepstrum (leave one song out). Step 1: stored clean targets of the 770 wide draws; on 402 delay-ons within 10% (3% secondary), log2 MAE, Spearman, paired vs F49's picker and the wide-draw median, by thirds; double/half lags; peak-height AUC all and strong third; 90% band-bootstrap intervals (2,000, seed 20261108). Stops if hits vs picker interval wholly below 0. Step 2: E0's 84 X-LANCE stems; per delay set (300 ms/0.40, 500/0.40, 500/0.15; 12 each) hits within 10% vs the 12 S stems at that lag and ~8% chance; subtraction arm descriptive there (its offs = E0's 48 S and reverb stems, in-sample). Positive control: plain pick on E0's renders without backing ({clean,crunch}-{S,delay-*}). Clearly (plain arm, only if it did not stop in step 1) = >= 4 of 12 on either mix-0.40 set (~1.1% a set by chance) and S <= 1 of 12. Not clearly -> masking renders (E1b, storing stem and mix audio) proposed next; clearly -> E1e: rebuild and re-separate the 770 wide draws (zero renders, ~55 min MPS), pass if stem hits beat the picker's on the same items (paired interval above 0) with log2 MAE below the prior's. Review: 3 required changes, all made.
